tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Return the lat/lon edges of a neighborhood or rough area. Call this only when you need those edges. For trends, call get_area_trends with the place name and skip this tool. The suggested query is a short incident list, not a trend summary.

tools.name: get_area_trends
tools.description: Start here for any neighborhood or trend question. Pass city and place, such as Milwaukee and Harbor View. tools.name: get_city_crimes
tools.description: One page of individual incidents inside a lat/lon box. Counts, shares, months, and streets belong on get_area_trends. tools.name: get_crime_stats
tools.description: Citywide counts, date range, and top crime types. There is no neighborhood or lat/lon filter. For a place, call get_area_trends.

tools.name: search_crimes
tools.description: Text search of crime types and descriptions. There is no neighborhood box. A place name such as Harbor View is usually absent from the incident text. For a place, call get_area_trends.
